name: Discord Bot (discord.py)
description: discord.py bot in an isolated virtualenv. No token is requested while creating the server; add DISCORD_TOKEN later under Startup & Env.
installScript: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt

files..env:
DISCORD_TOKEN=
# Add other secrets here. Only the panel owner (admin) can read this file.
files.bot.py:
import os

import discord
from discord.ext import commands


def load_env(path=".env"):
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        for line in handle:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
                continue
            key, value = line.split("=", 1)
            os.environ.setdefault(key.strip(), value.strip())


load_env()
token = os.environ.get("DISCORD_TOKEN")
if not token:
    raise SystemExit("DISCORD_TOKEN is not set yet. Add it under Startup & Env, then restart.")

intents = discord.Intents.default()
intents.message_content = True
bot = commands.Bot(command_prefix="!", intents=intents)


@bot.event
async def on_ready():
    print(f"Logged in as {bot.user}")


@bot.command()
async def ping(ctx):
    await ctx.reply("Pong!")


bot.run(token)
